# vercel logout

Sign out the currently authenticated user.

```
vercel logout
```

## Examples

Sign out the currently authenticated user.

```
$ vercel logout
```

Global options (`--cwd`, `--scope`, `--token`, `--debug`, ...) also apply; see `global-options.md`.
